notes: The two final display groups are conventionally grouped as North Dravidian; their common ancestry as a distinct subgroup is not assumed here.
Kuwi is the source dataset's spelling for Kuvi. Kodagu is also called Kodava. Only the 22 studied varieties are listed, not every language in each subgroup.

Naiki and Naikri remain separate source varieties, not independent branches. Gadaba includes the Dravidian source dialects collapsed by the existing analysis; this is not Gutob, the Austroasiatic language also called Gadaba.
A group receives a both-meaning or same-form credit only when one individual language supplies that whole connection. Meanings are not combined across languages.
